The '''ANx-y/2 sensor cluster''' was a sensor package designed by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]]. The system was installed in the standard model of the [[Starfeld Industries/Legends|Starfeld Industries]] [[Z-10 Seeker-class scout ship|Z-10 Seeker]].

It was almost identical to the sensor package found on the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing]], but lacked the lateral scanning arrays. This distinction reduced the detection range of the ANx-y/2 system but granted superior visibility for smaller ships like the Z-10 Seeker.

The detection modes of the ANx-y/2 system include [[Dedicated energy receptor/Legends|dedicated energy receptors]], [[Full-spectrum transceiver/Legends|Full-spectrum transceivers]], and [[life form indicator]]s.
